use std::{fs,path::PathBuf}; static LIBRARY_LOCK:std::sync::Mutex<()>=std::sync::Mutex::new(());
#[derive(Clone)] struct AppHandle{root:PathBuf} impl AppHandle {fn path(&self)->&Self{self} fn app_config_dir(&self)->Result<PathBuf,String>{Ok(self.root.clone())}}
fn data_dir(app:&AppHandle)->Result<PathBuf,String>{Ok(app.root.clone())} fn default_dir(app:&AppHandle)->Result<PathBuf,String>{Ok(app.root.clone())}
fn configured_dir(app: &AppHandle) -> Result<Option<PathBuf>, String> {
    let path = app
        .path()
        .app_config_dir()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        .join("blunted-folder.txt");
    let value = match fs::read_to_string(path) {
        Ok(v) => v,
        Err(_) => return Ok(None),
    };
    let dir = PathBuf::from(value.trim());
    if dir.is_dir() {
        Ok(Some(dir))
    } else {
        Ok(None)
    }
}

async fn blunted_clear(app: AppHandle) -> Result<(), String> {
    let _guard = LIBRARY_LOCK.lock().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut dirs = vec![data_dir(&app)?];
    let legacy = default_dir(&app)?;
    if !dirs.contains(&legacy) {
        dirs.push(legacy);
    }
    for dir in dirs {
        let articles = dir.join("articles");
        if articles.exists() {
            fs::remove_dir_all(articles).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        }
        if let Ok(name) = fs::read_to_string(dir.join("current-draft.txt")) {
            let candidate = name.trim();
            let name = if PathBuf::from(candidate)
                .file_name()
                .and_then(|v| v.to_str())
                == Some(candidate)
                && candidate.ends_with(".json")
            {
                candidate
            } else {
                "doc.json"
            };
            let _ = fs::remove_file(dir.join(name));
            let stem = name.strip_suffix(".json").unwrap_or(name);
            for n in 1..=3 {
                let _ = fs::remove_file(dir.join(format!("{}.backup.{}.json", stem, n)));
            }
        }
        for name in [
            "doc.json",
            "doc.backup.1.json",
            "doc.backup.2.json",
            "doc.backup.3.json",
            "doc.backup.json",
            "prefs.json",
            "current-draft.txt",
        ] {
            let _ = fs::remove_file(dir.join(name));
        }
    }
    let folder_config = app
        .path()
        .app_config_dir()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        .join("blunted-folder.txt");
    let _ = fs::remove_file(folder_config);
    Ok(())
}

fn main(){let root=std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("blunted-baseline-clear-{}",std::process::id()));fs::create_dir(&root).unwrap();let app=AppHandle{root:root.clone()};fs::write(root.join("doc.json"),"disposable writing").unwrap();fs::create_dir(root.join("prefs.json")).unwrap();fs::write(root.join("blunted-folder.txt"),root.join("missing-selected").display().to_string()).unwrap();println!("baseline configured missing root: {:?}",configured_dir(&app));let mut future=Box::pin(blunted_clear(app));let waker=std::task::Waker::noop();let mut cx=std::task::Context::from_waker(waker);println!("baseline clear result: {:?}",std::future::Future::poll(future.as_mut(),&mut cx));println!("prefs still exists after claimed success: {}",root.join("prefs.json").exists());fs::remove_dir_all(root).unwrap();}
